plans.idea: Faithful square adaptation of the original: small brand lockup top-left, headline and the feature copy in a wide left column beside the bottle, the 'Taste the Difference' pill anchored under the copy on the same left edge, legal as a quiet footer.

Headline-led top-to-bottom read: full-width copy block across the top half so the headline sets on one big line, then a bottom band where the pill and brand sign-off stack left and the bottle sits right.

Two-column product poster: brand lockup crowns a left column that holds the bottle, while a tall right column carries headline and features down to the pill, so image and message share a clear vertical gutter.
